g.text: DSTRUCT K3 C1 ↔ C3: strict 50% replacement
Dots: image means. Diamonds / bars: equal-image mean and 95% building-cluster bootstrap.
GS = (|QC−QA| + |QC−QB|)/2 − |QB−QA|; positive values mean greater cross-class change, not necessarily higher quality.
